build_PAAHead: build a PAAHead object detector with configurable topk score voting and covariance type parameters
run_loss_by_feat: run loss calculation for PAAHead using cls scores bbox preds and iou preds tensors
run_paa_reassign: run PAA reassignment to fit GMM distribution and separate positive ignore and negative samples
run_score_voting: run score voting on detected bboxes to refine positions using IoU weighted candidate boxes
run_predict_by_feat: run prediction by transforming head features into bbox results with NMS post processing
